none_intro: A federation is a set of groups sharing one ban list: someone banned in the federation is banned in every member group — at once, and again whenever they join or write. Create one (you become its owner) or join one with its code.
title: 🌐 Federation {name}
code_hint: Give it to the admins of other groups so they can join. A new code stops further joins with the old one.
how: Federation admins use /fban and /unfban in any member group.
admin_prompt: Who should be an admin of {name}? Pick with the button, forward a message from them, or send an id or a known @username.
admin_full: The federation already has the most admins it can have.
name_prompt: Send a name for the federation (up to {max} characters).
join_bad: No federation has that code. Check it and send it again, or /cancel.
join_other: This group is already in another federation — leave it first.
join_full: {name} already has the most groups it can have.
created: 🌐 Federation {name} created; this group is its first member.
code_new: 🔑 New join code made; the old one no longer works.
delete_q: Delete the federation {name}? Its ban list goes; bans already done in the groups stay.
leave_q: Take {title} out of {name}? Its bans will no longer apply here.
not_fed_admin: Only the federation's owner and admins can do this.
owner_only: Only the federation's owner can do this.
unbanned: ♻️ {name} unbanned in every group of the federation.
